about_the_game:
Travel back to the Warring States period and experience the thrill of chariots charging across the battlefield!

This game blends rich historical settings with intense, action-packed gameplay, immersing you in the epic clash between infantry and war chariots.

As the child of a renowned Warring States general, you will choose to side with either Prince Li or Prince Jia, fighting alongside them and uncovering a complex and gripping storyline. Face a variety of infantry formations, from sword-wielding soldiers and skilled archers to the unyielding spear phalanx.

With diverse formations, deep tactical gameplay, and dynamic battlefield changes, every battle is an unpredictable challenge filled with strategy and excitement!

Single-player mode - Qin attacked Zhao, with a total of 6 cities. Each city needs to conquer 4 scenes: front of the battle formation, under the city, inner city, and street fighting. Each victory will randomly unlock the plot fragments about Gongzi Jia

Infinite mode - Zhao attacked Qin, with unlimited cities. Each city needs to conquer 4 scenes: front of the battle formation, under the city, inner city, and street fighting. Each victory will randomly unlock the plot fragments about Gongzi Li

Formation mode - Each game has a fixed number of flag bearers, shield bearers, spearmen, short swordmen, and archers, which can be freely arranged into various formations

Network mode - Players can choose a horse-drawn chariot on one side, using the mobility of the chariot to charge, and a variety of formations composed of multiple infantry of different arms on the other side. Facing the chariot charge, you need to adjust the formation according to the situation

name: 嘉离代战
short_description: A historical meat-and-pigeon + strategy game set in the Warring States Period, where horse-drawn chariots fight against infantry. Players control chariots to fight against various infantry formations, while experiencing fascinating plots and exciting battles.
